entry_item.definition: n. Word, utterance; phrase; language, speech.

example.definition: To make a slip of the tongue.
To break one's promise, go back on one's word.
Without a word, silent[ly]; implicit[ly], unconditional[ly], obediently.
To question, take evidence; to extract a promise; to take someone's words into consideration; to follow instructions.
To find loopholes or weak spots in a speech or statement; to twist someone's words.
To cut short or interrupt a speech
To convince, persuade; to make obey.
Tb obey- or follow instructions; to yield to persuasion.
Sense or spirit of the expression.
To give one's promise or word; to inform; to remind.
Fine or nice word[s] or expression; word[s] worth remembering; good news.
Coarse or rude language; harsh words.
